title: Corner Regularity of Laplacian Eigenfunctions
summary: We study the regularity of eigenfunctions of the Dirichlet Laplacian on domains with corners. The specific question we consider is whether the eigenfunctions can be smooth, e.g. trigonometric, on the closure of their domain. We determine how this regularity depends on the local geometry of the corner. Local asymptotic analysis provides detailed information about eigenfunctions near corners and allows us to quantify the Hölder regularity of the normal derivative.
